conclusion: No blocking defect found. The complete chain matches the supplied frozen-GOLA/C1, active-ABC, LasHeR/RGBT234, seed42 scope. No implementation repairs are required.

findings.subject: Actual split, shard and schema interfaces
findings.evidence: The saved real preparation receipt contains 1762 unique TRAIN queries on all881 names and196 unique developer queries on all98 names, twice per name and disjoint. These names equal the accepted previous train/validation metadata. Actual shard counts are440/440/441/441 and49/49/49/49. Merger checks completed sources, all finite arrays, matching dtypes/trailing shapes and exact ordered jobs, concatenates every archive field, and reload-compares every field. No array is dropped by merging. Cache gate binds both accepted partitions, common teacher/data configuration, all schema fields and disjoint complete video coverage.

findings.subject: Current/history GT and causal supervision
findings.evidence: Merger independently recomputes valid current and all recorded valid-past IoUs from TRAIN GT, verifies exact past frame indices ending at query-1, and checks own-policy old4 epoch provenance and three-step future labels. The actual module has19 decision fields excluding all five label fields and motion_targets. Collector copies these decision arrays before future decoding; private per-action histories are source-inspected. Future labels are finite/range/provenance checked, not independently replayed by the CPU merger.

findings.subject: Accepted private implementation and frozen C1
findings.evidence: The old private package has a saved real import acceptance and39 Python sources including research/__init__.py. Its recoverability_modules hash equals the inspected current module. The new controller copies that package to a new isolated root and replaces only the trainer. Entire trainer AST equals the archived accepted trainer after six declared retention/docstring changes; optimizer, loss, forward, seed and evaluation logic are unchanged. GPU fit cwd and PYTHONPATH select the new package; CPU fit replay uses that same package. Native evaluator remains in main GOLA. C1 requires_grad is false, C1 gradients are absent, and every retained payload is checked tensor-for-tensor against fixed C1.

findings.subject: M0, all60 epochs and retained payloads
findings.evidence: Four arms are pairwise/budgeted x1e-4/1e-5 with seed42, selector supervision, B384 and no frozen A/B/C flags. M0 uses the full1762/196 merged data for3epochs=15 optimizer updates and must pass actual CPU audit before any full fit. Each full run starts again from old4 and executes60epochs xceil(1762/384)=300 updates; no early stopping or retry. Audit checks all epoch records, exact first/last-step logging, positive finite ABC gradient evidence, ABC weight changes and CPU validation replay. Fixed epochs20/40/60 and cached best are retained with compatible module/model/epoch/args/validation payloads. best epoch0 may legitimately remain the parent; fixed trained checkpoints are still available.

findings.subject: Full98 continuous checkpoint selection
findings.evidence: The unchanged evaluator reads all frames of precisely the original98 developer videos. Historical completed receipts confirm these names and49418frames. The new scorer uses actual TRAIN init.txt GT through ground_truth/localization_quality, excludes initialization and invalid GT by the existing diagnostic mask, and selects equal-weight sequence mean IoU. Every fixed20/40/60 candidate is evaluated; cached best is included only for positive epochs not already evaluated in that arm. Python max applies the declared order on ties. The old4 epoch0 parent remains a historical reference and cannot be selected as a newly trained checkpoint. Native-test scores are not read for this selection.

findings.subject: Wait timing, launch and error propagation
findings.evidence: The controller initially writes WAIT then sleeps until Oct5 03:00 CST before reading original collection launch/markers or using ps. Missing completion markers trigger checks of the four original recorded runner PIDs every180 seconds. It never restarts or edits collectors. All dependent CPU subprocesses use argv lists and check=True; wave detects nonzero GPU exits, and Bash uses set-euo-pipefail. Fixtures confirmed failed review, missing collector, failed GPU child, failed M0 audit, failed full audit, failed native report or failed native audit cannot write final completion. GPU checks are index/memory.used only; no power or temperature queries/settings exist.

findings.subject: Complete native coverage and official metric semantics
findings.evidence: Exact shell routing covers LasHeR indices0..244 once andRGBT234 indices0..233 once, with full frames and the same selected checkpoint. Merge requires actual four-shard completion, exact names/full frame totals245/220703 and234/116649, same config/checkpoint, finite raw predictions and all prediction/latency/decision files. It hardlinks raw files without prediction edits. Merger and independent native audit are whole-AST identical to previously accepted sources after run/variant-name substitutions. The latter retains the installed NPR/PR/SR LasHeR sequential nonpositive-size previous-box handling only in memory; no inference crop or raw rewriting is introduced. RGB-T MPR/MSR arithmetic is unchanged.

findings.subject: Full reports, paired uncertainty, mechanism and final five-key schema
findings.evidence: Exact report command fragments parse against actual repository argument parsers. Both datasets invoke original core metrics for baseline/C1/new, both paired reports and5000 sequence resamples with seed42, all native curves/attributes, and full mechanism diagnostics. Independent CPU audit requires exact overall/per-sequence/attribute/curve and paired-bootstrap equality before returning. The final controller consumes the actual full_report.json structure variants[label].overall_metrics_percent[key], emits PR/NPR/SR andMPR/MSR in that order, and calculates each baseline+2 target and delta. Running the whole controller with saved previous real report values verified this final JSON schema. Final completion reports actual execution completion separately from whether all five improvement targets are met.

findings.subject: Retention and scientific interpretation
findings.evidence: No weight deletion is included in this controller; all retained candidates remain available until separately authorized post-scoring cleanup. GOLA/C1 and auxiliary pretrained components stay frozen while all three requested modules remain active. Training uses two cached query states perTRAIN video, not all-frame/end-to-end visual-backbone optimization. Developer videos have been repeatedly used and prior native results guided development; the score file/plan explicitly avoid untouched-holdout claims. One seed satisfies the supplied scope; no new multi-seed requirement was added.

limitations: No SSH, live-job poll, GPU query, neural forward, optimizer step, actual dataset/GT read or actual checkpoint read was performed by this reviewer. Supplied running-collection status and saved receipts are historical/context evidence, not a fresh runtime observation.

Controller and scoring fixtures used in-memory filesystem/process/array stand-ins. Native arithmetic was checked against the accepted corrected source and installed-source archive; new native numerical acceptance must still run on actual completed outputs.
New-data GPU memory capacity is not attested here. The actual full-new-data3epoch M0 and its CPU acceptance must finish before the reviewed controller proceeds to60epochs.
Actual merged arrays, C1 tensor equality,300 real updates, retained-checkpoint CPU replay, full98 scores and new native metrics are future runtime gates, not established by source PASS.
When a wave child fails the controller stops continuation; other already-started children can finish their current work. There is no automatic retry or relaunch.

Raw future teacher labels are not independently recomputed. The original19/12 native attribute structures and five metric keys were checked using saved actual prior reports; their new values remain unknown.
